summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Kartu Peserta (Exam Card) feature and PUT /api/settings/school theme_color preservation fix. All backend APIs (9/9 tests passed), frontend integration, and testable regression items verified successfully.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/cards/class/{class_id}/pdf returns 200 for admin and guru, 403 for siswa, 404 for invalid class
Backend: PDF content includes student names, NISN/NIP, class name, email, school identity (SMA Contoh Nusantara), and session information
Backend: Optional session_id filter correctly limits card to single session
Backend: PDF includes embedded logo image objects
Backend: PUT /api/settings/school preserves theme_color when field is omitted
Backend: PUT /api/settings/school updates theme_color when field is provided
Frontend: 'Kartu' button (data-testid exam-cards-{classId}) present on class cards in Manajemen Kelas
Frontend: 'Kartu' button downloads kartu-peserta-{class}.pdf successfully with success toast
Frontend: Pengaturan Sekolah page saves successfully without breaking theme
Regression: Session Excel export working (GET /api/export/session/{id}/xlsx - 6.3KB file)
Regression: Rapor siswa PDF working (GET /api/report/student/{id}/pdf - 2.9KB file)
Regression: Rapor kelas PDF working (tested via frontend)
Regression: Leaderboard API working (GET /api/leaderboard/class/{id} returns correct ranking data)

untestable_items: Kartu hasil PDF (GET /api/results/detail/{attempt_id}/pdf) - requires completed exam attempts in database
Exam retake flow - requires active exam session and student participation
5-option questions - requires taking an exam with 5-option questions
notes.reason: These items require complex test data setup (students taking exams, completing attempts) which is beyond the scope of this testing iteration. The APIs exist and are structurally correct based on code review.
